mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (member_id, created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, now())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE cart_id IN (SELECT cart_id FROM cart WHERE member_id = (SELECT member_id FROM orders WHERE order_number = #{orderNumber})) AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_detail WHERE orders_id = (SELECT orders_id FROM orders WHERE order_number = #{orderNumber}))
